card.name: Linking words before security forces
card.fires_on: Small linking words (that, by, the, or, 's) in human rights report text, right where 'security forces' or police and military abusers are about to be named. Also fires on word starts in political violence passages.

modes.label: Human rights report links
modes.description: A linking word just before security forces or officials are named as the actors in abuses.
modes.example: Incidents of serious human rights abuses in some areas—including unlawful killings<< by>> security forces and vigilante killings—incre

modes.label: Political violence narratives
modes.description: Words or word starts in accounts of state violence, war or repression.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'security' next, as in 'security forces'.
card.plain: It lights up when a human rights report is about to say 'security forces' as the ones doing the harm.
